wordmark.purpose: "Good Catch" in the header only; cream and gold with a 3px bark stroke.

score.purpose: The n/6 on result and catch panels; 4px bark stroke.

title.purpose: Panel headings and today's species name.

body.purpose: Page default, log rows, streak line.

dialogue.purpose: The cat's line in the bubble; legend keys.

label.purpose: Chips, cell tags, notes, week-day marks.

caption.purpose: Date under the wordmark, today's-fish caption.

shadows.name: furniture
shadows.purpose: filter on every wood and parchment panel, icon buttons, plaque, bubble.

shadows.name: window
shadows.purpose: filter on the sea frame only.

shadows.name: face
shadows.purpose: filter on the cat face sprite.

shadows.name: wordmark-stroke
shadows.purpose: Wordmark only; the score uses a 4px stroke without the drop.

motion.name: board-tick
motion.purpose: Canvas redraw step; seabed frame alternates every 8 ticks (1s).

motion.name: cast-line
motion.purpose: Line arcs from rod tip to square, then ring (800ms) and, on a catch, splash and leap (900ms).

motion.name: catch-scene-frame
motion.purpose: Frame step of the live 80x64 catch scene.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Stops CSS animation and the canvas loop; casts resolve instantly.

components.name: Gold Button
components.description: The one action on screen (Cast, Share, Got it, Close). Presses down 2px; no hover colour.

components.name: Disabled Button
components.description: The gold frame drained to driftwood; Cast before a square is chosen.

components.name: Wood Icon Button
components.description: 48px header button on a nailed plank frame holding a pixel sprite or the language code.

components.name: Speech Bubble
components.description: The cat speaks from a parchment bubble with a two-layer pixel tail pointing at its face.
components.html: There’s a golden fish around today! Tap a square to read the water.

components.name: Habit Chip
components.description: One habit of the selected square, with a thumbnail cut from the real seabed renderer.

components.name: Cell Read Tag
components.description: The bite count (0-3) in a cast square’s corner; 3 switches to the gold frame.

components.name: Cast Plaque
components.description: Single-row wood plaque: bobbers left, the gold Cast button right.
components.css: .ds-plaque{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;max-width:420px;padding:8px 12px;background:#8B5A2B;border:3px solid #2E1A0C;box-shadow:inset 3px 3px 0 #B97A45,inset -3px -3px 0 #5E3A1A;clip-path:polygon(3px 0,calc(100% - 3px) 0,100% 3px,100% calc(100% - 3px),calc(100% - 3px) 100%,3px 100%,0 calc(100% - 3px),0 3px);filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 10px rgba(4,16,26,.4))} .ds-bobs{display:flex;gap:2px} .ds-bobs i{width:16px;height:22px;background:linear-gradient(#D8553A 0 50%,#F4EFE6 50%);border:2px solid #2E1A0C} .ds-bobs i.used{opacity:.3;filter:grayscale(1)} .ds-btn-gold{border:3px solid #2E1A0C;background:#F2B33D;box-shadow:inset 3px 3px 0 #FFD97A,inset 0 -4px 0 #B97A1F;color:#3B2414;font:400 28px/1 "Jersey 10",ui-rounded,system-ui,sans-serif;padding:4px 18px 8px;cursor:pointer;clip-path:polygon(3px 0,calc(100% - 3px) 0,100% 3px,100% calc(100% - 3px),calc(100% - 3px) 100%,3px 100%,0 calc(100% - 3px),0 3px)} .ds-btn-gold:active{transform:translateY(2px)}

components.name: Week Strip
components.description: Seven tag-framed days; today uses the gold frame; caught days show the species sprite.
components.html: ThuFriSat
components.css: .ds-week{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,64px);gap:4px} .ds-day{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:2px;min-height:52px;background:#F6E7C1;border:2px solid #2E1A0C;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #E0C58B;clip-path:polygon(3px 0,calc(100% - 3px) 0,100% 3px,100% calc(100% - 3px),calc(100% - 3px) 100%,3px 100%,0 calc(100% - 3px),0 3px);color:#6B4A2A;font:400 20px/1 "Jersey 10",ui-rounded,system-ui,sans-serif} .ds-day small{font-size:16px} .ds-day b{font-weight:400} .ds-day.ds-today{background:#F2B33D;box-shadow:inset 2px 2px 0 #FFD97A,inset 0 -2px 0 #B97A1F} .ds-fish{width:28px;height:18px;background:#F2C84B;border:2px solid #2E1A0C}

components.name: Parchment Panel
components.description: Reading surface for the log, journal, legend and dialogs.
components.css: .ds-panel{background:#F6E7C1;border:3px solid #2E1A0C;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px #E0C58B;clip-path:polygon(3px 0,calc(100% - 3px) 0,100% 3px,100% calc(100% - 3px),calc(100% - 3px) 100%,3px 100%,0 calc(100% - 3px),0 3px);padding:12px 14px;max-width:420px;color:#3B2414;filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 10px rgba(4,16,26,.4))} .ds-panel h2{margin:0 0 6px;font:400 26px/1 "Jersey 10",ui-rounded,system-ui,sans-serif} .ds-panel p{margin:0;font:400 22px/1.15 "Jersey 10",ui-rounded,system-ui,sans-serif}

narrative.overview:
The sea is not a board, it is a window. The player looks down through clear water at a real seabed whose sand, coral, rock and kelp run across square boundaries, and the three facts the puzzle asks about (bottom, depth, light) are drawn as light: a sunlit caustic net where the sun reaches, a dithered cloud shadow where it does not, a pale shelf edge where the water drops. Everything around the window is the dock's own furniture: pixel-drawn wood planks with nails, sun-faded parchment, and gold buttons, all generated as 9-slice frames from a single integer pixel grid at runtime.

The page itself is the deep water around the dock: a teal gradient (lagoon surface to abyss) under a faint 32-pixel caustic tile, so even the margins read as sea. The single font, Jersey 10, carries every word from the 84px score to the 16px weekday, always weight 400, always pixel-crisp. A cat is the voice: its face sits beside a parchment speech bubble at the top, its back is drawn on the wooden pier at the bottom of the lagoon, rod in paw, and it reappears in the 80x64 catch scene that takes the foreground when the day ends.

Density is that of a handheld game screen: one 480px column, a board scaled to the largest integer pixel multiple that fits both width and height, and furniture panels stacked beneath it. Nothing is smooth-scaled; nothing is rounded; depth comes from soft drop-shadow filters under hard pixel silhouettes.
keyCharacteristics: One integer pixel grid: every canvas draws at 1x and scales by a whole factor with smoothing off; every sprite carries a 1px bark outline.
Furniture vocabulary of five 9-slice frames (wood, parchment, tag, gold, dull), with stepped (notched) corners instead of radii.
Jersey 10 only, weight 400, sized by role from 16px to 84px.
Light is information: sun, shade and depth are rendered as lighting on the seabed, never as icons or outlines.
Motion is pixel-stepped: sprites bob a pixel, selection pulses in two steps, the board animates on a 125ms tick.

rules.name: The Water Eats Red Rule
rules.body: Anything under the surface is filtered toward turquoise and darkened with depth; anything above it (pier, beach, cat, bobbers, the caught fish leaping out) keeps full colour. A new underwater element is drawn in true colour and run through the same filter, never hand-picked teal.

rules.name: The One Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold means the action you can take now, or a win. A surface that is neither stays parchment or wood.

rules.name: The Sun Is Selection Rule
rules.body: Sun Glint appears only on what is selected, focused or revealed. It is never a fill for a static surface.

rules.name: The Single Face Rule
rules.body: Jersey 10 at weight 400, everywhere. Emphasis is size, colour or the bark stroke; `<b>` is reset to 400.

rules.name: The Stroke For Shouting Rule
rules.body: Only the wordmark and the score get the 8-direction bark outline. Everything else is plain text on its surface.

rules.name: The Silhouette Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are filters that follow the pixel outline. A rectangular box-shadow under a notched frame is wrong.

dos: **Do** draw every new graphic at 1x on the integer pixel grid, with a 1px bark outline, and scale it by a whole number with smoothing off.
**Do** frame new surfaces with one of the five 9-slice frames (wood for structure, parchment for reading, tag for small items, gold for the action or a win, dull for disabled).
**Do** use `filter: drop-shadow` in abyss blue-black for depth (0 8px 10px at .4 for furniture).
**Do** set every word in Jersey 10 at weight 400, choosing a size from the hierarchy above.
**Do** run anything underwater through the clear-water filter, and express bottom, depth and light as lighting on the seabed.
**Do** keep the board at the largest integer scale that fits beside the Cast button in the first viewport.
**Do** make every icon a pixel sprite (the help "?" and the collection book are sprites).
donts: **Don't** use border-radius on frames, buttons or panels; corners are one-pixel steps.
**Don't** smooth-scale a canvas or sprite, or use a fractional scale.
**Don't** outline the board as a flat grid of boxed squares; squares are read through the water, separated only by faint corner sparkles.
**Don't** use sun yellow as a static fill, or gold on anything that is not an action or a win.
**Don't** add a second typeface or a bold weight, and don't stroke text other than the wordmark and the score.
**Don't** use rectangular box-shadows under notched frames.
